title: Safer updates and quick support links
summary: Update announcements require HTTPS links, rollback keeps backups safe if Arras moves during an update, and the status menu adds quick Support and Rate links.
details: Open update announcement links only when they point to an HTTPS website without embedded credentials.
Preserve the previous app backup if Arras is moved during an update, leaving both the moved copy and any replacement untouched.
Add Support Arras in the direct-download menu bar and Rate Arras in the Mac App Store menu bar, plus an optional native App Store rating prompt after three active days.
